source: You cause up to six pillars of stone, each 5 feet in diameter and up to 30 feet high, to burst from the ground at points you can see. A creature in a pillar's space is pushed aside or, if it cannot be, takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage when it is pinned against a ceiling, halved on a successful Dexterity saving throw.

You cut yourself with a jewelled dagger, taking 2d4 piercing damage that cannot be healed until the spell ends, and shape a homunculus servant. It obeys your commands, acts on your turn, and can deliver a bite that grants you temporary hit points drawn from the target.
Druid Grove

You ward an area up to 90 feet on a side. You choose which creatures pass freely, and the rest face entangling plants, an alarm that only you hear, an illusion of thick woodland, and druidic guardians that lash at intruders.
Platinum Shield

A field of platinum light protects a creature you can see. It gains half cover, resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning and poison damage, and takes no damage on a successful Dexterity save for half. As a bonus action you can move the field to another creature within 60 feet.
Gravity Fissure

A crack of gravitational energy opens along a 100-foot line, 5 feet wide. Each creature in it makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 force damage on a failure and half on a success; creatures within 10 feet of the line are pulled toward it and take the same damage if they fail.
Investiture of Flame

Flames wreathe your body for the duration. You are immune to fire damage and resistant to cold, you shed bright light, any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of you takes 1d10 fire damage, and as an action you can create a 15-foot line of fire for 4d8 fire damage, halved on a successful Dexterity saving throw.
Investiture of Ice

Frost covers your body for the duration. You are immune to cold damage and resistant to fire, ice spreads from you in a 10-foot radius as difficult terrain, and as an action you can exhale a 15-foot cone of freezing wind for 4d6 cold damage and halved speed, with a Constitution saving throw for half damage and no slowing.
Investiture of Stone

Bits of rock cover your body for the duration. You have resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage, you can move through solid earth as if it were difficult terrain, and as an action you can shake the ground in a 15-foot radius, knocking creatures prone on a failed Dexterity saving throw.
Investiture of Wind

Wind swirls around you for the duration. Ranged weapon attacks against you have disadvantage, you gain a flying speed of 60 feet, and as an action you can create a 15-foot cube of whirling wind that deals 2d10 bludgeoning damage on a failed Constitution saving throw, half on a success.
Mental Prison

You trap a creature in an illusory cage of its own worst memories. On a failed Intelligence saving throw it takes 5d10 psychic damage and is restrained, perceiving itself surrounded by a hazard only it can see. When the spell ends it takes 10d10 psychic damage.
Primordial Ward

Acid, cold, fire, lightning and thunder damage are all halved against you for the duration. Taking damage of one of those types, you may spend a reaction to shed every resistance in exchange for outright immunity to that one type until your next turn ends.
Scatter

The air crackles with teleportation magic. You choose up to five creatures you can see within range and teleport each one up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. An unwilling creature can resist with a Wisdom saving throw.
Soul Cage

You snatch the departing soul and trap it in your cage, preventing it being raised. While you hold it you can spend one of its five charges to heal yourself 2d8, gain advantage on a roll, ask the soul a question, steal a glimpse through its eyes, or add 2d8 to a necromancy spell's damage.
Summon Fiend

You call a fiendish spirit to an unoccupied space you can see. You choose a Demon, Devil or Yugoloth form, and it acts on your turn using your spellcasting numbers, obeying your commands while you concentrate.
Otherworldly Guise

You draw on the Lower or Upper Planes. Either way you are immune to fire and poison or to radiant and necrotic damage, cannot be charmed or frightened, gain a flying speed of 40 feet, add your spellcasting modifier to your AC, and can attack twice with weapons or cantrips.
Arcane Transformation

You channel magic into fighting prowess. You gain 50 temporary hit points, advantage on attack rolls with simple and martial weapons, an extra attack with the Attack action, proficiency with martial weapons and Constitution saves, and an extra 2d12 force damage on weapon hits. You cannot cast spells while transformed, and when the spell ends you suffer a level of exhaustion.
Crown of Stars

Seven star-like motes circle your head, shedding bright light. As a bonus action you can hurl one at a creature within 120 feet, making a ranged spell attack for 4d12 radiant damage on a hit. When four or fewer motes remain the spell no longer sheds light.
Draconic Transformation
You take on draconic aspects: blindsight out to 30 feet, a 60-foot flying speed, and an action to exhale a 60-foot cone dealing 6d8 force damage, halved on a successful Dexterity saving throw.
Dream of the Blue Veil
You and up to eight willing creatures fall into a shared dream and wake on another world you have seen depicted, arriving in an unoccupied space of that world's choosing.
Temple of the Gods
